blocks.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *govoriti, from Proto-Indo-European *gewH- (“to call, cry”) with a *-b⁽ʰ⁾- enlargement, perhaps connected to the synonymous *ǵʰewH-. Cognate to Polish gaworzyć, Czech hovořit, Ukrainian говорити, Serbo-Croatian гово̀рити, Persian گفتن (goftan) (“to say, to speak”).
